additional_info.body:
Dear Nicolas,
I hope all is well with you. I'm Sambath, and I'll be supporting you on this case from expert team. I investigated the problem, and it is related to the
"ID0367767-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/PPN 170001303] Type 2 AC socket issue"
situation. The primary cause of both issues is the same. There is a communication breakdown on the charger PLC side, and a reboot resolves the problem. Please be informed that I will be in contact with Region France to resolve the issue as soon as possible.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S

The status / error message on SCB changes to "Outlet : outoforder, LEMState : Working" as shown on my ticket.

additional_info.body:
Hello Franck,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0368666 ﻿from the eMobility HQ DC Queue (Level 3)  to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2), due to one or more following reason (s) :
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Yes
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Yes
Spare Part Ordering
Yes
Performance monitoring by RC
Issue :
Charger outlets are going out of order randomly and PLC (10.20.17.10) part of the charger is not accessible. Reboot fixes the issue temporarily but the issue reappear continuously.
Suspected Root Cause :
CPU error-  Hardware configuration error
Check List during site intervention :
Check all the hardware connection of KF1, Incase if any loose connection needs to be corrected.
If everything ( Hardware connections) is okay, Please proceed to replace KF1 with new one.
Incase if you need any support during the site intervention, please feel free to inform me prior.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue, or manually using the "Assign" function from the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue (Level 2) and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team, using "Assign" function and then move the case to eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) using "Add to Queue".
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Sambath KS
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
